description: Stay up-to-date with web-site content changes.

promotion.reason: Approved by the owner. Qualified as offered on 2026-09-12: a real install of changedetection.io 0.60.4, upstream's current release proved it starts, opens to a first screen with a clear next step, survives a restart and a keep-data reinstall with its data intact, and removes everything it created. The definition comes from CapRover's one-click apps.

data_storage: A Docker volume Local Store manages for changedetection
risk_notes: Creates 1 Docker container and publishes one port on this computer's loopback interface only.
Keeps its data in a Docker volume that Local Store manages for it. A keep-data uninstall leaves the volume; deleting data removes it permanently.
Proven on Windows with Docker's Linux engine. macOS and Linux hosts are unverified.
Watches the pages you add, on the schedule you set, fetching them from this computer.
Notifications need a service you configure — email, ntfy, and so on — and nothing is sent until you do.
Pages that only render with a browser need the separate Playwright container upstream suggests, which is not included here.
